summary: Built a small Python FastAPI sample that stores provider profiles in an Azure DocumentDB collection with embedded vectors and exposes a /find-provider endpoint that performs vector search using the cluster's cosmosSearch vector index. The sample includes an idempotent seed script that creates a vector-hnsw index (1536 dims) and upserts 10 synthetic provider documents with embeddings. Embeddings are produced by OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is provided, otherwise by a deterministic fallback so the sample runs in this environment. I verified dependency installation, seeding, index creation (via the documentdb MCP), sample queries, and unit tests. LlamaIndex/OpenAI runtime integration was intentionally left optional because of dependency resolution conflicts; instructions to enable them are documented in README.
how_to_run:
1) Python virtualenv: python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
2) pip install -r requirements.txt
3) cp .env.example .env and set DOCUMENTDB_URI (and optionally OPENAI_API_KEY)
4) python seed.py    # creates collection, vector index, and upserts sample documents
5) python query_demo.py "Spanish-speaking cardiologist accepting Medicare" 5   # run a one-shot demo query
6) Optionally run the API server: uvicorn app.main:app --reload and POST to /find-provider with JSON {"query":"...","k":5}

Notes: If you want LlamaIndex/OpenAI embedding support, install the packages (see README) and set OPENAI_API_KEY. I intentionally left LlamaIndex/OpenAI optional to keep the sample runnable without external keys and to avoid dependency conflicts in this environment.

open_issues: LlamaIndex/OpenAI dependency conflicts: attempting to include llama-index plus a pinned openai caused pip dependency resolution conflicts in this environment. I removed llama-index/openai from the runtime requirements so the sample and tests run (with deterministic fallback embeddings). To enable LlamaIndex/OpenAI locally, install 'llama-index' and a compatible 'openai' release as documented in README.

The sample uses deterministic fallback embeddings when OPENAI_API_KEY is not present; results are deterministic but not semantically meaningful. To evaluate real semantic ranking, set OPENAI_API_KEY and re-seed data so embeddings are computed by the chosen model (text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dims).
Tests: integration-style server tests are skipped to avoid starting a live server during CI. The unit tests that run here cover seed/index creation (mocked) and the fallback embedding generator.
